name: SimpleServe API
description:
The SimpleServe API provides a small customer-facing surface for discovering and
running AI agents.

A run can return text, files, structured data, and customer-visible tool
records. Read `output` for the complete result. `output_text` contains the
text items when the result includes text.

Continue work by creating a new run with `session_id`. SimpleServe manages
provider-specific persistence behind that field. Session routes provide
the signed-in user's chat history.

`max_cost_usd` is an optional hard authorization ceiling. When omitted,
SimpleServe uses the agent's published maximum. The provider must stop before its
actual cost passes the effective limit. SimpleServe does not require a quote.

Publishers use `/v1/publisher/*` to create, test, and release native
SimpleServe agents. SimpleServe manages execution for every buyer.
